feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 27 November 2026 4:00pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 27 November 2026 at 4:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds later.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure near Iceland and high pressure over Scandinavia.


##Wind##

Northwest or variable 2 to 4 in most waters, but southeast 4 or 5 in eastern waters at first, settling east or southeast 3 to 5 later this evening, then increasing southeast 4 to 6 early tonight and then 5 to 7 by the end of the night. Further increasing 6 to gale 8 for a time Saturday afternoon, then starting to veer west later.


##State of Sea##

Slight becoming moderate by the morning, occasionally rough in the northeast later.


##Weather##

Risk of mist in the east of the area, then rain arriving Saturday morning.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in the east in any mist, then occasionally moderate or poor in rain later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Soon becoming west 5 or 6, backing southwest later Saturday evening. Increasing 6, occasionally 7 for a time Sunday morning.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, occasionally rough at first and later.


##Weather##

Rain at first, then showers later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain.
